newsitem.title: USA: Commerce corrects Feb U.S. trade deficit.
newsitem.headline: Commerce corrects Feb U.S. trade deficit.

text.p: The Commerce Department said Thursday the correct U.S. trade deficit for February was $10.4 billion instead of $11.59 billion as it reported earlier in the day.

The Commerce Department said "reporting errors" at several ports of entry had led to $1.1 billion of crude petroleum imports from prior periods being incorrectly shown as arriving in February. As a result, the entire monthly trade deficit figure was overstated.
